title: Local cell update
statement: Given a machine action, a new head summary, and left, central, and right cell encodings, the updated cell carries the new head summary exactly when the central cell carried some head summary; otherwise it carries none. For each work tape, it retains the central cell's symbol unless its Boolean marker is true, in which case it uses the action's optional write value with the old symbol as default; its new Boolean value is the central marker for a stationary move, the left neighbor's marker for a positive move, and the right neighbor's marker for a negative move.
